stumbles.quote: Rescoring depends only on how the index was built.
stumbles.why: Says rescoring depends only on build, but the `--bits` section and search flags are separate; it's unclear whether any search flag can enable/disable rescoring or whether `--keep-float` is a build option of a command not shown. The README never shows how to build an index.
The build command is never shown or explained here, so I don't know where this flag goes or what it stores.

stumbles.quote: `--bits` sets the quantization width used for the search.
stumbles.why: Unclear whether the index must have been built with a matching bit width, and what values are valid besides 2 and 4.

stumbles.quote: each search rescores its top 100 candidates
stumbles.why: Unclear how this interacts with `-k` (e.g. if k exceeds 100) and whether the 100 is configurable.
Doesn't say whether this figure is with or without rescoring, so it can't be tied to the rescoring paragraph. 'EmbeddingGemma test set' is also unexplained.
Doesn't say what the score is (distance or similarity) or whether higher is better, nor what the ids refer to.

stumbles.quote: `query` is the query's line number in `QUERY_FILE`.
stumbles.why: Doesn't say whether numbering starts at 0 or 1; the example shows 1 but it's not stated, and blank lines are not addressed.

point: remex search takes an index and a file of comma-separated query vectors, returns top-k ids and scores per query as JSON Lines, and trades recall for speed via --bits, with float rescoring only if the index was built with --keep-float.
